newsitem.title: UK: Bank of England profit dips in latest year.
newsitem.headline: Bank of England profit dips in latest year.

text.p: The Bank of England said its banking department made a pre-tax profit of 121.3 million stg in the year to February 28 compared to 214.4 million stg in the previous year.
The dip was caused by the fact that in the previous year, the Bank made a profit of 118.4 million stg from the sale of shares it held in venture capital company 3i.
The Bank paid 48.7 million stg to the Treasury from its profits compared to 88 million stg the year before and had a tax bill of 23.8 million stg compared to 38.1 million.
At the end of its financial year, the Bank had assets of some 6.3 billion stg, two thirds of which are in the form of loans and advances to the money market, banks and customers.
Its salaries bill was 95.5 million stg, slightly lower than the year before, of which Governor Eddie George received an unchanged 227,000 stg.
